business_invariants.name: order_financial_reconciliation
business_invariants.description: Order total must equal subtotal - discount + tax + shipping across all orders
business_invariants.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM orders WHERE ABS(total_amount - (subtotal_amount - discount_amount + tax_amount + shipping_amount)) > 0.01;

business_invariants.name: payment_reconciliation
business_invariants.description: Successful payments must match or cover the order total amount
business_invariants.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'successful' AND ABS(o.total_amount - p.amount) > 0.01;

business_invariants.name: order_item_line_total_reconciliation
business_invariants.description: Order item line total must equal quantity * unit_price
business_invariants.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM order_items WHERE ABS(line_total - (quantity * unit_price)) > 0.01;

business_invariants.name: refund_ceiling_reconciliation
business_invariants.description: Total refund amount per order must not exceed order total amount
business_invariants.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM (SELECT r.order_id, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS total_refunded, o.total_amount FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'completed' GROUP BY r.order_id, o.total_amount HAVING total_refunded > o.total_amount + 0.01);

business_invariants.name: chronological_sequence_invariant
business_invariants.description: Shipment date must be on or after order creation date
business_invariants.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.shipped_at < o.order_date;

business_invariants.name: customer_address_integrity
business_invariants.description: All customer addresses must reference valid existing customers
business_invariants.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orphan_count FROM customer_addresses ca LEFT JOIN customers c ON ca.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL;

business_invariants.name: product_review_range
business_invariants.description: Review ratings must strictly be between 1 and 5
business_invariants.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invalid_count FROM product_reviews WHERE rating < 1 OR rating > 5;
